name: Rosa Delgado
sayings: El elefante se comió a la hormiga
remembrance: Rosa grew up in Oaxaca, near the market in Tlacolula, and later lived for forty years in San Antonio. Every Sunday, she made tamales de rajas and a big pot of champurrado, and she always sang Cielito Lindo while she cooked. When we left her house, she always said, ‘Ve con Dios, mijo.’
